versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֖לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת הַשְּׁבָטִ֑ים מִקְצֵ֣ה צָפ֡וֹנָה אֶל־יַ֣ד דֶּֽרֶךְ־חֶתְלֹ֣ן׀ לְֽבוֹא־חֲמָ֡ת חֲצַ֣ר עֵינָן֩ גְּב֨וּל דַּמֶּ֤שֶׂק צָפ֨וֹנָה֙ אֶל־יַ֣ד חֲמָ֔ת וְהָיוּ־ל֧וֹ פְאַת־קָדִ֛ים הַיָּ֖ם דָּ֥ן אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: Now these are the names of the tribes: From the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar Enan at the border of Damascus, northward beside Hamath, (and they shall have their sides east and west), Dan, one portion.
controles.kjv: Now these are the names of the tribes. From the north end to the coast of the way of Hethlon, as one goeth to Hamath, Hazar–enan, the border of Damascus northward, to the coast of Hamath; for these are his sides east and west; a portion for Dan.
controles.livre: E estes são os nomes das tribos: Desde o extremo norte, do lado do caminho de Hetlom, vindo para Hamate, Hazar-Enom, ao limite de Damasco, para o norte, ao lado de Hamate; sendo seus extremos do oriente e do ocidente: esta é a porção de Dã.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֣ל׀ גְּב֣וּל דָּ֗ן מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ים עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה אָשֵׁ֥ר אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: By the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side, Asher, one portion.
controles.kjv: And by the border of Dan, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Asher.
controles.livre: Junto ao limite de Dã, desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Aser.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֣ל׀ גְּב֣וּל אָשֵׁ֗ר מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָה וְעַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה נַפְתָּלִ֥י אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: By the border of Asher, from the east side even to the west side, Naphtali, one portion.
controles.kjv: And by the border of Asher, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Naphtali.
controles.livre: Junto ao limite de Aser, desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Naftali.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֣ל׀ גְּב֣וּל נַפְתָּלִ֗י מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛מָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: By the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west side, Manasseh, one portion.
controles.kjv: And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Manasseh.
controles.livre: Junto ao limite de Naftali, desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Manassés.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֣ל׀ גְּב֣וּל מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛מָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה אֶפְרַ֥יִם אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: By the border of Manasseh, from the east side to the west side, Ephraim, one portion.
controles.kjv: And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Ephraim.
controles.livre: Junto ao limite de Manassés, desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Efraim.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֣ל׀ גְּב֣וּל אֶפְרַ֗יִם מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ים וְעַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה רְאוּבֵ֥ן אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: By the border of Ephraim, from the east side even to the west side, Reuben, one portion.
controles.kjv: And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Reuben.
controles.livre: Junto ao limite de Efraim, desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Rúben.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֣ל׀ גְּב֣וּל רְאוּבֵ֗ן מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ים עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה יְהוּדָ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: By the border of Reuben, from the east side to the west side, Judah, one portion.
controles.kjv: And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Judah.
controles.livre: Junto ao limite de Rúben, desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Judá.

versos.hebraico: וְעַל֙ גְּב֣וּל יְהוּדָ֔ה מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֖ים עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֑מָּה תִּהְיֶ֣ה הַתְּרוּמָ֣ה אֲֽשֶׁר־תָּרִ֡ימוּ חֲמִשָּׁה֩ וְעֶשְׂרִ֨ים אֶ֜לֶף רֹ֗חַב וְאֹ֜רֶךְ כְּאַחַ֤ד הַחֲלָקִים֙ מִפְּאַ֤ת קָדִ֨ימָה֙ עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֔מָּה וְהָיָ֥ה הַמִּקְדָּ֖שׁ בְּתוֹכֽוֹ׃

controles.web: By the border of Judah, from the east side to the west side, shall be the offering which you shall offer, twenty-five thousand reeds in breadth, and in length as one of the portions, from the east side to the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in its midst.
controles.kjv: And by the border of Judah, from the east side unto the west side, shall be the offering which ye shall offer of five and twenty thousand reeds in breadth, and in length as one of the other parts, from the east side unto the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.
controles.livre: E junto ao limite de Judá, desde o lado do oriente até o lado do ocidente, será a oferta que reservareis, de vinte e cinco mil canas de largura, e de comprimento, como uma das demais partes, desde o lado do oriente até o lado do ocidente; e o santuário estará no meio dela.

versos.hebraico: הַתְּרוּמָ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּרִ֖ימוּ לַֽיהוָ֑ה אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְרֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִֽים׃

controles.web: The offering that you shall offer to Yahweh shall be twenty-five thousand reeds in length, and ten thousand in breadth.
controles.kjv: The oblation that ye shall offer unto the Lord shall be of five and twenty thousand in length, and of ten thousand in breadth.
controles.livre: A oferta que reservareis ao SENHOR será de vinte e cinco mil canas de comprimento e dez mil de largura.

versos.hebraico: וּ֠לְאֵ֜לֶּה תִּהְיֶ֣ה תְרֽוּמַת־הַקֹּדֶשׁ֮ לַכֹּֽהֲנִים֒ צָפ֜וֹנָה חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֣ים אֶ֗לֶף וְיָ֨מָּה֙ רֹ֚חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֔ים וְקָדִ֗ימָה רֹ֚חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֔ים וְנֶ֕גְבָּה אֹ֕רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף וְהָיָ֥ה מִקְדַּשׁ־יְהוָ֖ה בְּתוֹכֽוֹ׃

controles.web: For these, even for the priests, shall be the holy offering: toward the north twenty-five thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in breadth, and toward the east ten thousand in breadth, and toward the south twenty-five thousand in length: and the sanctuary of Yahweh shall be in its midst.
controles.kjv: And for them, even for the priests, shall be this holy oblation; toward the north five and twenty thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in breadth, and toward the east ten thousand in breadth, and toward the south five and twenty thousand in length: and the sanctuary of the Lord shall be in the midst thereof.
controles.livre: E ali será a oferta santa dos sacerdotes, de vinte e cinco mil canas ao norte, dez mil de largura ao ocidente, dez mil de largura ao oriente, e de vinte e cinco mil de comprimento ao sul; e o santuário do SENHOR estará no meio dela.

versos.hebraico: לַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים הַֽמְקֻדָּשׁ֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י צָד֔וֹק אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמְר֖וּ מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֑י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־תָע֗וּ בִּתְעוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּע֖וּ הַלְוִיִּֽם׃ס

controles.web: It shall be for the priests who are sanctified of the sons of Zadok, who have kept my instruction, who didn’t go astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.
controles.kjv: It shall be for the priests that are sanctified of the sons of Zadok; which have kept my charge, which went not astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.
controles.livre: Será para os sacerdotes santificados dos filhos de Zadoque, que guardaram minha ordem, que não se desviaram quando os filhos de Israel se desviaram, como se desviaram os outros levitas.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיְתָ֨ה לָהֶ֧ם תְּרוּמִיָּ֛ה מִתְּרוּמַ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָדָשִׁ֑ים אֶל־גְּב֖וּל הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

controles.web: It shall be to them an offering from the offering of the land, a thing most holy, by the border of the Levites.
controles.kjv: And this oblation of the land that is offered shall be unto them a thing most holy by the border of the Levites.
controles.livre: Eles terão uma oferta da oferta da terra, a parte santíssima, junto ao limite dos levitas.

versos.hebraico: וְהַלְוִיִּ֗ם לְעֻמַּת֙ גְּב֣וּל הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֨לֶף֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וְרֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֑ים כָּל־אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְרֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִֽים׃

controles.web: Answerable to the border of the priests, the Levites shall have twenty-five thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth: all the length shall be twenty-five thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.
controles.kjv: And over against the border of the priests the Levites shall have five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth: all the length shall be five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.
controles.livre: E o Levitas terão na vizinhança do limite dos sacerdotes vinte e cinco mil canas de comprimento e de dez mil de largura; todo o comprimento será vinte e cinco mil, e a largura dez mil.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹא־יִמְכְּר֣וּ מִמֶּ֗נּוּ וְלֹ֥א יָמֵ֛ר וְלֹ֥א יעבור רֵאשִׁ֣ית הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּי־קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: They shall sell none of it, nor exchange it, nor shall the first fruits of the land be alienated; for it is holy to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And they shall not sell of it, neither exchange, nor alienate the firstfruits of the land: for it is holy unto the Lord.
controles.livre: Não venderão disto, nem trocarão, nem transferirão as primícias da terra, pois é coisa consagrada ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַחֲמֵ֨שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֜ים הַנּוֹתָ֣ר בָּרֹ֗חַב עַל־פְּנֵ֨י חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף חֹֽל־ה֣וּא לָעִ֔יר לְמוֹשָׁ֖ב וּלְמִגְרָ֑שׁ וְהָיְתָ֥ה הָעִ֖יר בתוכה׃

controles.web: The five thousand that are left in the breadth, in front of the twenty-five thousand, shall be for common use, for the city, for dwelling and for suburbs; and the city shall be in its midst.
controles.kjv: And the five thousand, that are left in the breadth over against the five and twenty thousand, shall be a profane place for the city, for dwelling, and for suburbs: and the city shall be in the midst thereof.
controles.livre: E as cinco mil canas de largura que restam das vinte e cinco mil, serão de uso comum para a cidade, para habitação e arrebaldes; e a cidade estará no meio delas.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵלֶּה֮ מִדּוֹתֶיהָ֒ פְּאַ֣ת צָפ֗וֹן חֲמֵ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּפְאַת־נֶ֕גֶב חֲמֵ֥שׁ חמש מֵא֖וֹת וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֑ים וּמִפְּאַ֣ת קָדִ֗ים חֲמֵ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּפְאַת־יָ֕מָּה חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וְאַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִֽים׃

controles.web: These shall be its measures: the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.
controles.kjv: And these shall be the measures thereof; the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.
controles.livre: E estas serão suas medidas: o lado norte quatro mil e quinhentas canas ,o lado sul quatro mil e quinhentas, o lado do oriente quatro mil e quinhentas, e o lado do ocidente quatro mil e quinhentas.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֣ה מִגְרָשׁ֮ לָעִיר֒ צָפ֨וֹנָה֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתַ֔יִם וְנֶ֖גְבָּה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתָ֑יִם וְקָדִ֨ימָה֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתַ֔יִם וְיָ֖מָּה חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃

controles.web: The city shall have suburbs: toward the north two hundred fifty, and toward the south two hundred fifty, and toward the east two hundred fifty, and toward the west two hundred fifty.
controles.kjv: And the suburbs of the city shall be toward the north two hundred and fifty, and toward the south two hundred and fifty, and toward the east two hundred and fifty, and toward the west two hundred and fifty.
controles.livre: E o arrebaldes da cidade serão ao norte de duzentas e cinquenta canas ,ao sul de duzentas e cinquenta, ao oriente de duzentas e cinquenta, e ao ocidente de duzentas e cinquenta.

versos.hebraico: וְהַנּוֹתָ֨ר בָּאֹ֜רֶךְ לְעֻמַּ֣ת׀ תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֗דֶשׁ עֲשֶׂ֨רֶת אֲלָפִ֤ים קָדִ֨ימָה֙ וַעֲשֶׂ֤רֶת אֲלָפִים֙ יָ֔מָּה וְהָיָ֕ה לְעֻמַּ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְהָיְתָ֤ה תבואתה לְלֶ֔חֶם לְעֹבְדֵ֖י הָעִֽיר׃

controles.web: The remainder in the length, answerable to the holy offering, shall be ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward; and it shall be answerable to the holy offering; and its increase shall be for food to those who labor in the city.
controles.kjv: And the residue in length over against the oblation of the holy portion shall be ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward: and it shall be over against the oblation of the holy portion; and the increase thereof shall be for food unto them that serve the city.
controles.livre: E quanto ao que restar do comprimento, na vizinhança da oferta santa, será dez mil canas ao oriente e dez mil ao ocidente, que será vizinho à oferta santa; sua produção será alimento dos trabalhadores da cidade.

versos.hebraico: וְהָעֹבֵ֖ד הָעִ֑יר יַעַבְד֕וּהוּ מִכֹּ֖ל שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Those who labor in the city, out of all the tribes of Israel, shall cultivate it.
controles.kjv: And they that serve the city shall serve it out of all the tribes of Israel.
controles.livre: E os trabalhadores da cidade, de todas as tribos de Israel, trabalharão nela.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הַתְּרוּמָ֗ה חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף רְבִיעִ֗ית תָּרִ֨ימוּ֙ אֶת־תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ אֶל־אֲחֻזַּ֖ת הָעִֽיר׃

controles.web: All the offering shall be a square of twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand: you shall offer it as a holy offering, with the possession of the city.
controles.kjv: All the oblation shall be five and twenty thousand by five and twenty thousand: ye shall offer the holy oblation foursquare, with the possession of the city.
controles.livre: Toda a oferta será de vinte e cinco mil canas por vinte e cinco mil, em quadrado; reservareis a oferta santa, com a propriedade da cidade.

versos.hebraico: וְהַנּוֹתָ֣ר לַנָּשִׂ֣יא מִזֶּ֣ה׀ וּמִזֶּ֣ה׀ לִתְרֽוּמַת־הַקֹּ֣דֶשׁ וְלַאֲחֻזַּ֪ת הָעִ֟יר אֶל־פְּנֵ֣י חֲמִשָּׁה֩ וְעֶשְׂרִ֨ים אֶ֥לֶף׀ תְּרוּמָה֮ עַד־גְּב֣וּל קָדִימָה֒ וְיָ֗מָּה עַל־פְּ֠נֵי חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֨לֶף֙ עַל־גְּב֣וּל יָ֔מָּה לְעֻמַּ֥ת חֲלָקִ֖ים לַנָּשִׂ֑יא וְהָֽיְתָה֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וּמִקְדַּ֥שׁ הַבַּ֖יִת בתוכה׃

controles.web: The remainder shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy offering and of the possession of the city; in front of the twenty-five thousand of the offering toward the east border, and westward in front of the twenty-five thousand toward the west border, answerable to the portions, it shall be for the prince: and the holy offering and the sanctuary of the house shall be in its midst.
controles.kjv: And the residue shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy oblation, and of the possession of the city, over against the five and twenty thousand of the oblation toward the east border, and westward over against the five and twenty thousand toward the west border, over against the portions for the prince: and it shall be the holy oblation; and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the midst thereof.
controles.livre: E o que restar será para o príncipe, de um lado e do outro da oferta santa, e da propriedade da cidade, desde a distância de vinte e cinco mil canas da oferta, até o extremo oriente, e ao ocidente desde a distância de vinte e cinco mil canas da oferta até o extremo ocidente, na vizinhança das porções das tribos ,será para o príncipe; e a oferta santa, e o santuário da casa será no meio dela.

versos.hebraico: וּמֵאֲחֻזַּ֤ת הַלְוִיִּם֙ וּמֵאֲחֻזַּ֣ת הָעִ֔יר בְּת֛וֹךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַנָּשִׂ֖יא יִֽהְיֶ֑ה בֵּ֣ין׀ גְּב֣וּל יְהוּדָ֗ה וּבֵין֙ גְּב֣וּל בִּנְיָמִ֔ן לַנָּשִׂ֖יא יִהְיֶֽה׃

controles.web: Moreover from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the midst of that which is the prince’s, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, it shall be for the prince.
controles.kjv: Moreover from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the midst of that which is the prince’s, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.
controles.livre: E desde a propriedade dos Levitas, e desde a propriedade da cidade, será no meio daquilo que pertencerá ao príncipe. Entre o limite de Judá e o limite de Benjamim será para o príncipe.

versos.hebraico: וְיֶ֖תֶר הַשְּׁבָטִ֑ים מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה בִּנְיָמִ֥ן אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: As for the rest of the tribes: from the east side to the west side, Benjamin, one portion.
controles.kjv: As for the rest of the tribes, from the east side unto the west side, Benjamin shall have a portion.
controles.livre: E quanto às demais tribos: desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Benjamim.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֣ל׀ גְּב֣וּל בִּנְיָמִ֗ן מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה שִׁמְע֥וֹן אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: By the border of Benjamin, from the east side to the west side, Simeon, one portion.
controles.kjv: And by the border of Benjamin, from the east side unto the west side, Simeon shall have a portion.
controles.livre: E junto ao limite de Benjamim, desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Simeão.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֣ל׀ גְּב֣וּל שִׁמְע֗וֹן מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה יִשָׂשכָ֥ר אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: By the border of Simeon, from the east side to the west side, Issachar, one portion.
controles.kjv: And by the border of Simeon, from the east side unto the west side, Issachar a portion.
controles.livre: E junto ao limite de Simeão, desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Issacar.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֣ל׀ גְּב֣וּל יִשָׂשכָ֗ר מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה זְבוּלֻ֥ן אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: By the border of Issachar, from the east side to the west side, Zebulun, one portion.
controles.kjv: And by the border of Issachar, from the east side unto the west side, Zebulun a portion.
controles.livre: E junto ao limite de Issacar, desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Zebulom.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֣ל׀ גְּב֣וּל זְבוּלֻ֗ן מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛מָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה גָּ֥ד אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: By the border of Zebulun, from the east side to the west side, Gad, one portion.
controles.kjv: And by the border of Zebulun, from the east side unto the west side, Gad a portion.
controles.livre: E junto ao limite de Zebulom, desde o extremo oriente até o extremo ocidente: esta é a porção de Gade.

versos.hebraico: וְעַל֙ גְּב֣וּל גָּ֔ד אֶל־פְּאַ֖ת נֶ֣גֶב תֵּימָ֑נָה וְהָיָ֨ה גְב֜וּל מִתָּמָ֗ר מֵ֚י מְרִיבַ֣ת קָדֵ֔שׁ נַחֲלָ֖ה עַל־הַיָּ֥ם הַגָּדֽוֹל׃

controles.web: By the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar to the waters of Meribath Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea.
controles.kjv: And by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar unto the waters of strife in Kadesh, and to the river toward the great sea.
controles.livre: E junto ao limite de Gade, ao sul, no lado sul, será o limite desde Tamar até as águas das inimizades de Cades, junto ao ribeiro, até o grande mar.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֥את הָאָ֛רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־תַּפִּ֥ילוּ מִֽנַּחֲלָ֖ה לְשִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ מַחְלְקוֹתָ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ

controles.web: This is the land which you shall divide by lot to the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their several portions, says the Lord Yahweh.
controles.kjv: This is the land which ye shall divide by lot unto the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their portions, saith the Lord God.
controles.livre: Esta é a terra que repartireis em herança às tribos de Israel, e estas são suas porções,diz o Senhor DEUS.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֖לֶּה תּוֹצְאֹ֣ת הָעִ֑יר מִפְּאַ֣ת צָפ֔וֹן חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת וְאַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִ֖ים מִדָּֽה׃

controles.web: These are the exits of the city: On the north side four thousand and five hundred reeds by measure;
controles.kjv: And these are the goings out of the city on the north side, four thousand and five hundred measures.
controles.livre: E estas são as saídas da cidade: ao lado norte quatro mil e quinhentos côvados de medida.

versos.hebraico: וְשַׁעֲרֵ֣י הָעִ֗יר עַל־שְׁמוֹת֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שְׁעָרִ֥ים שְׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה צָפ֑וֹנָה שַׁ֣עַר רְאוּבֵ֞ן אֶחָ֗ד שַׁ֤עַר יְהוּדָה֙ אֶחָ֔ד שַׁ֥עַר לֵוִ֖י אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: and the gates of the city shall be after the names of the tribes of Israel, three gates northward: the gate of Reuben, one; the gate of Judah, one; the gate of Levi, one.
controles.kjv: And the gates of the city shall be after the names of the tribes of Israel: three gates northward; one gate of Reuben, one gate of Judah, one gate of Levi.
controles.livre: E as portas da cidade serão conforme os nomes das tribos de Israel; três portas ao norte: uma porta de Rúben, uma porta de Judá, e uma porta de Levi.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶל־פְּאַ֣ת קָדִ֗ימָה חֲמֵ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּשְׁעָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה וְשַׁ֨עַר יוֹסֵ֜ף אֶחָ֗ד שַׁ֤עַר בִּנְיָמִן֙ אֶחָ֔ד שַׁ֥עַר דָּ֖ן אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: At the east side four thousand and five hundred reeds, and three gates: even the gate of Joseph, one; the gate of Benjamin, one; the gate of Dan, one.
controles.kjv: And at the east side four thousand and five hundred: and three gates; and one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, one gate of Dan.
controles.livre: E ao lado do oriente quatro mil e quinhentos côvados ,e três portas: uma porta de José, uma porta de Benjamim, e uma porta de Dã.

versos.hebraico: וּפְאַת־נֶ֗גְבָּה חֲמֵ֨שׁ מֵא֜וֹת וְאַרְבַּ֤עַת אֲלָפִים֙ מִדָּ֔ה וּשְׁעָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה שַׁ֣עַר שִׁמְע֞וֹן אֶחָ֗ד שַׁ֤עַר יִשָּׂשכָר֙ אֶחָ֔ד שַׁ֥עַר זְבוּלֻ֖ן אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: At the south side four thousand and five hundred reeds by measure, and three gates: the gate of Simeon, one; the gate of Issachar, one; the gate of Zebulun, one.
controles.kjv: And at the south side four thousand and five hundred measures: and three gates; one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, one gate of Zebulun.
controles.livre: E ao lado sul quatro mil e quinhentos côvados de medida, e três portas: uma porta de Simeão, uma porta de Issacar, e uma porta de Zebulom.

versos.hebraico: פְּאַת־יָ֗מָּה חֲמֵ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֔ים שַֽׁעֲרֵיהֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה שַׁ֣עַר גָּ֞ד אֶחָ֗ד שַׁ֤עַר אָשֵׁר֙ אֶחָ֔ד שַׁ֥עַר נַפְתָּלִ֖י אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: At the west side four thousand and five hundred reeds, with their three gates: the gate of Gad, one; the gate of Asher, one; the gate of Naphtali, one.
controles.kjv: At the west side four thousand and five hundred, with their three gates; one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, one gate of Naphtali.
controles.livre: E ao lado do ocidente quatro mil e quinhentos côvados ,e suas três portas: uma porta de Gade, uma porta de Aser, e uma porta de Naftali.

versos.hebraico: סָבִ֕יב שְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָ֑לֶף וְשֵׁם־הָעִ֥יר מִיּ֖וֹם יְהוָ֥ה׀ שָֽׁמָּה׃

controles.web: It shall be eighteen thousand reeds around: and the name of the city from that day shall be, Yahweh is there.
controles.kjv: It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be, The Lord is there.
controles.livre: Ao redor terá dezoito mil côvados . E o nome da cidade desde aquele dia será: O SENHOR Está Ali.
